text: dsh-paste-to-path（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：把粘贴、拖放或选择的文件保存到 DSH Host，并把路径作为附件引用交给会话。它在 DSH Web composer 提供附件 Dock、文件选择入口和粘贴处理；默认保留 DSH Native 的普通附件流程，也可开启经典路径附件接管。主要功能包括文件附件管理、长文本转 TXT、Host 绝对路径引用，以及小型文本附件编辑。适合需要把本地文档、代码或长文本交给 DSH Agent 后续工具处理的用户。使用前需要安装到 Web profile；无需额外 API Key，附件保存在 Host 工作区或 DSH_HOME 下。

dsh-paste-to-path (DSH Web) saves pasted, dropped, or selected files on the DSH Host and passes paths into conversations. It adds an attachment dock; long pastes become TXT files, existing Host paths can be linked, and small text attachments edited. Install in a Web profile; no API key needed.
想把粘贴或拖进 DSH Web 的文件保存成路径附件，之后让 Agent 工具读取。
有没有办法把一大段粘贴文本变成 TXT 附件，避免直接塞进输入框？
我想把 DSH Host 上已有的绝对路径粘贴到对话里作为附件引用。
能在发送前从附件面板查看或编辑小型文本文件吗？
Can I attach a file in the DSH Web composer and pass its host path to agent tools?
How can I turn a long paste into a text file attachment instead of putting it all in chat?
dsh-paste-to-path 的功能「文件附件 Dock」：在经典接管模式下，用户可粘贴、拖放或选择文件，上传到 DSH Host 后在 Dock 中管理附件卡片。
dsh-paste-to-path 的功能「长文本转附件」：粘贴文本达到可配置阈值时将其作为 TXT 文件上传，默认阈值为 8000 字符。
dsh-paste-to-path 的功能「引用 Host 路径」：将已存在于 DSH Host 的绝对路径转换为附件引用，供对话传递路径。
dsh-paste-to-path 的功能「编辑文本附件」：用户可在附件卡片中读取并保存符合大小限制的文本或代码文件。
dsh-paste-to-path 的功能「附件路径交付」：上传的内容保存到工作区或 DSH_HOME 下，发送时通过引用生成路径说明供 Agent 后续工具使用。
dsh-paste-to-path 使用前须知：文件会保存到 DSH Host 本地文件系统的工作区 .dsh/pastes 或 DSH_HOME/tmp-paste；插件传递路径，不负责解析文件内容。
Can I attach local documents to a DSH chat so the agent can read them with its available tools?
想把本地代码文件拖到 DSH 输入框，再由 Agent 的工具读取路径。

dsh-paste-to-path README · dsh-paste-to-path：> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Final release — v0.0.7**
>
> DSH now provides an official generic-file attachment pipeline, so the compatibility gap this plugin was created to fill has been closed. Version `0.0.7` is the final release; no further versions are planned.
>
> DSH Native owns ordinary files and images by default. Enable **Take over DSH Native attachments** only when you explicitly want the classic path-backed P2P workflow. Long-text conversion remains independently available.

dsh-paste-to-path README · dsh-paste-to-path：The rest of this README documents the classic P2P workflow available when takeover is enabled.

`dsh-paste-to-path` adds a general-purpose attachment Dock to the DSH Web composer.

Paste, drop, or choose images, PDFs, Word and Excel documents, archives, code, logs, and other files, then review and manage them together before sending.

dsh-paste-to-path README · dsh-paste-to-path：

Images, PDFs, archives, and other formats share one attachment Dock.

dsh-paste-to-path README · dsh-paste-to-path：The DSH `0.1.2-rc.1` Web composer has a native image attachment path, but PDFs, Office documents, archives, and other formats do not have the same model-independent entry point. Even an image may fail when the selected model does not support image input or the active adapter is text-only.

`dsh-paste-to-path` does not extend the model's native content types. It takes a simpler route:

```text
File
  ↓
DSH Host
  ↓

dsh-paste-to-path README · dsh-paste-to-path：Send images to your own vision tool, PDFs to a document reader, and archives to shell or extraction tools.

The plugin owns **attachment intake, management, and path delivery**. Your Agent tool stack decides how to read the file.

---

dsh-paste-to-path README · Path flow at a glance：

The file is saved on the DSH Host, then its path is given to the Agent.

---

dsh-paste-to-path README · Universal attachment Dock：Paste, drop, or choose a file and an attachment card appears above the composer. The plugin's paperclip button accepts any file type and routes it through this Dock rather than DSH's native image rail.

Each card shows the file name, size, category, and path. You can remove it before sending.

Images also have thumbnails and lightbox previews.

---

dsh-paste-to-path README · File-manager clipboard support：The plugin catches every real `File` object exposed by the browser, including empty files. It can also turn a pasted `file:` URI or absolute path into a card when that path already exists on the DSH Host.

Path conversion is transactional: every candidate path must exist on the DSH Host. If any candidate is unavailable, the original clipboard text is pasted normally without an attachment error or a partial conversion.

dsh-paste-to-path README · File-manager clipboard support：Browsers do not consistently expose non-image files copied from Windows Explorer, Finder, or Linux file managers. If the paste event contains neither file bytes nor a usable Host path, an ordinary web page cannot reconstruct the hidden OS clipboard entry. To address [Issue #2](https://github.com/Johnny-xuan/dsh-paste-to-path/issues/2), the plugin reads Explorer's `FileDropList` at this point when DSH runs on a local Windows Host through a direct `localhost` connection; remote clients never access the Host clipboard. In other cases, use the plugin's paperclip button or drag and drop. A path from a remote browser's device is not a path on the DSH Host.

dsh-paste-to-path README · One flow for many file types：Images, PDFs, Office documents, code, logs, archives, and other binary files all use the same attachment flow:

```text
File → Save on Host → Path reference → Agent
```

You do not need a separate model-input protocol for every file type.

---
section: One flow for many file types

text:
dsh-paste-to-path README · Turn long pasted text into an attachment：Normal text still pastes normally.

When pasted content crosses the configured threshold, the plugin can save it as a `.txt` file instead of putting tens of thousands of characters directly into the composer.

The default threshold is `8000` characters.

---
section: Turn long pasted text into an attachment

text:
dsh-paste-to-path README · Edit text files before sending：Text and code attachments can be edited directly in the Dock when they are below the configured size limit.

The default limit is 1 MiB.

---

dsh-paste-to-path README · Open files with the system application：For a local DSH deployment, the authenticated `session.openWorkspacePath` Remote API can open an attachment with the system's default application.

section: Open files with the system application

text:
dsh-paste-to-path README · Installation：Install into a DSH Web profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-paste-to-path
```

You can also install the current GitHub branch directly:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Johnny-xuan/dsh-paste-to-path
```

Restart DSH after installation:

```bash
dsh web
```

The package includes a `dsh.bundle` manifest, so the required loader patch is loaded with the plugin.

---

dsh-paste-to-path README · How it works：When you paste, drop, or choose a file, the plugin catches it and saves a private copy on the DSH Host:

```text
<workspace>/.dsh/pastes/<category>/
```

The composer does not contain the file's contents. It keeps an attachment reference instead.

If you paste an absolute path that already exists on the DSH Host, the plugin links that existing file instead of copying it. Linked files are never editable from the Dock.

dsh-paste-to-path README · How it works：When you send the message, DSH's reference codec expands that reference into a short path instruction:

```text
Paste / drop file
        │
        ▼
Save on DSH Host

The implementation uses DSH's extension mechanisms:

- `conversation.input.dock`
- `conversation.input.left`
- input-trigger reference codec
- `settingsScope`

No DSH core modification is required.

---

dsh-paste-to-path README · What the Agent receives：The plugin does not put file bytes in the initial model request.

For example, a PDF expands to:

```text
Document attachment: /absolute/path/to/report.pdf
Read it using an appropriate tool for this file format.
```

An image expands similarly:

```text
Image attachment: /absolute/path/to/image.png
Inspect it using an available image-reading method.
```

Text, code, archives, and other formats receive equivalent path instructions.

dsh-paste-to-path README · What the Agent receives：The instructions do not require a particular tool. The Agent decides what to do next from the tools that are actually available in the current session.

---

dsh-paste-to-path README · Bring your own tools：`dsh-paste-to-path` does not parse file contents.

Connect whichever tools fit your Agent environment, for example:

- images → your own `read_image` or vision tool
- PDF / Word / Excel → document readers
- scans → OCR
- code / logs → shell or filesystem tools
- ZIP / TAR → archive extractors

The plugin does not install these tools or assume that the current model has their capabilities.

Any compatible tool that can access the file path on the DSH Host can read the stored attachment.

dsh-paste-to-path README · Bring your own tools：If the Agent has no suitable tool, the file still enters the Dock and is saved on the Host, but the Agent cannot understand its contents.

---

dsh-paste-to-path README · Why paths：In DSH's native attachment path, supported file formats and model capabilities are closely related.

In DSH `0.1.2-rc.1`, the native Web image intake accepts:

- PNG
- JPEG
- WebP
- GIF

Other MIME types do not enter the same native image path.

An image that passes the format check may still fail if it reaches a model without image input or a text-only adapter.

`dsh-paste-to-path` separates two concerns:

```text
Give the file to the Agent
```

and:

```text
Understand the file's contents
```

dsh-paste-to-path README · Why paths：The plugin handles only the first.

The file becomes an ordinary file on the Host. The Agent's tool layer handles the second.

---

dsh-paste-to-path README · Configuration：Version `0.0.7` exposes two primary choices:

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Take over DSH Native attachments** | Off | When enabled, files, images, paste, drop, the picker, and the attachment Dock all use classic P2P. When disabled, ordinary attachments stay entirely with DSH Native. |
| **Turn long pasted text into an attachment** | On | Converts qualifying plain-text pastes into `.txt` attachments. This works with either attachment owner. |

dsh-paste-to-path README · Configuration：The long-text character threshold is a subordinate setting of the second option. It defaults to `8000` and remains editable from the plugin settings page.

The corresponding profile defaults are:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: paste-to-path
      name: dsh-paste-to-path
      config:

With takeover off, P2P does not register its file picker or Dock and does not consume ordinary file paste or drop events. With takeover on, the complete classic workflow described in this README becomes active.

dsh-paste-to-path README · Configuration：The settings UI follows DSH's **Language** preference and includes English and Simplified Chinese. Path instructions sent to the Agent remain stable English protocol text.

---

dsh-paste-to-path README · File storage：With a workspace, attachments are stored under:

```text
<workspace>/.dsh/pastes/<category>/
```

Without a workspace, storage falls back to:

```text
$DSH_HOME/tmp-paste/<category>/
```

Files copied into plugin storage use permissions:

```text
0600
```

An existing Host path pasted as an attachment is linked in place. The plugin does not copy it, change its permissions, or allow Dock editing of the original file.

dsh-paste-to-path README · File storage：Removing an attachment from the Dock removes only its reference from the current draft. It does not delete the file from disk.

The path therefore remains valid for undo, re-send, or later reference.

---

dsh-paste-to-path README · Privacy：Files chosen, dropped, or exposed as browser `File` objects are uploaded to your own DSH Host and saved on its local filesystem. Existing Host paths are only linked in place.

In classic takeover mode, every plugin HTTP route uses DSH's browser authentication and Host/Origin trust checks. Attachment records are isolated by session, and route registrations are removed with the plugin's Cordis lifecycle.

The plugin itself does not:

dsh-paste-to-path README · Privacy：- upload files directly to a model provider
- upload files to a third-party file service
- parse file contents during upload

The initial model request contains only the file path and a short instruction.

If the Agent later uses another tool or external service to process the file, that tool's own behavior and configuration apply.

---

dsh-paste-to-path README · Design boundary：`dsh-paste-to-path` owns only this part:

```text
File
  ↓
Attachment Dock
  ↓

This part:

```text
Path
  ↓
Vision / PDF Reader / OCR / Shell / ...
```

belongs to the Agent's tool layer.

The plugin therefore does not:

- modify or replace a model adapter
- pretend that the model supports vision
- bind the workflow to a fixed vision, OCR, or document tool
- parse attachment contents during transport
- create a native DSH `image` content block

---

dsh-paste-to-path README · Compatibility：The final release, `0.0.7`, targets:

```text
DeepSeek Harness >= 0.1.5-rc.1 and < 0.2.0
```

It has been tested with DSH `0.1.6-alpha.2`. Users maintaining older DSH installations without official generic-file attachments can pin `dsh-paste-to-path@0.0.6`.

No further plugin releases are planned because DSH now owns and maintains the attachment architecture this project originally supplied.
